limits: Public/authorized API visibility only; private/deleted/unlisted repositories or removed/unadvertised branches cannot be reviewed. Counts match each root public forks_count at snapshot; this is not a claim about invisible GitHub members.

Precise searches were complete for their queries, not exhaustive discovery of renamed detached mods. The five discovered Neko identities are a bounded related sample; the entire separate eight-fork Neko network was not enumerated.
